title: Lover

cues.en: We could leave the Christmas lights up 'til January
cues.zh: 我們可以把聖誕彩燈一路留到一月份
cues.text: We could leave the Christmas lights up 'til January

cues.en: And this is our place, we make the rules
cues.zh: 因為這是屬於我們的天地，規則由我們自訂
cues.text: And this is our place, we make the rules

cues.en: And there's a dazzling haze, a mysterious way about you dear
cues.zh: 你身上總籠罩著一抹令人眩暈的迷霧與神秘氣息，親愛的
cues.text: And there's a dazzling haze, a mysterious way about you dear

cues.en: Have I known you 20 seconds or 20 years?
cues.zh: 我究竟才認識了你二十秒，還是已經相伴了二十年？
cues.text: Have I known you 20 seconds or 20 years?

cues.en: Can I go where you go?
cues.zh: 你去哪裡，我能跟著你去嗎？
cues.text: Can I go where you go?

cues.en: Can we always be this close forever and ever?
cues.zh: 我們能永遠永遠都如此緊緊相依嗎？
cues.text: Can we always be this close forever and ever?

cues.en: And ah, take me out, and take me home
cues.zh: 帶我盛裝出門約會，再帶我溫柔回家
cues.text: And ah, take me out, and take me home

cues.en: You're my, my, my, my lover
cues.zh: 你是我此生唯一的、親愛的戀人
cues.text: You're my, my, my, my lover

cues.en: We could let our friends crash in the living room
cues.zh: 我們可以讓好友們隨意倒在客廳沙發過夜
cues.text: We could let our friends crash in the living room

cues.en: This is our place, we make the call
cues.zh: 這是屬於我們的小窩，一切由我們說了算
cues.text: This is our place, we make the call

cues.en: And I'm highly suspicious that everyone who sees you wants you
cues.zh: 我總是無比懷疑，任何看過你一眼的人都會忍不住想擁有你
cues.text: And I'm highly suspicious that everyone who sees you wants you

cues.en: I've loved you three summers now, honey, but I want 'em all
cues.zh: 親愛的，我已經愛了你三個盛夏，但我貪心地想要往後的每一個夏天
cues.text: I've loved you three summers now, honey, but I want 'em all

cues.en: Can I go where you go?
cues.zh: 你去哪裡，我能跟著你去嗎？
cues.text: Can I go where you go?

cues.en: Can we always be this close forever and ever?
cues.zh: 我們能永遠永遠都如此緊緊相依嗎？
cues.text: Can we always be this close forever and ever?

cues.en: And ah, take me out, and take me home
cues.zh: 帶我盛裝出門約會，再帶我溫柔回家
cues.text: And ah, take me out, and take me home

cues.en: Forever and ever, you're my, my, my, my lover
cues.zh: 朝朝暮暮，你是我此生唯一的、親愛的戀人
cues.text: Forever and ever, you're my, my, my, my lover

cues.en: Ladies and gentlemen, will you please stand?
cues.zh: 各位女士先生們，請大家全體起立好嗎？
cues.text: Ladies and gentlemen, will you please stand?

cues.en: With every guitar string scar on my hand
cues.zh: 憑藉著我指尖上每一道吉他弦留下的琴繭印記
cues.text: With every guitar string scar on my hand

cues.en: I take this magnetic force of a man to be my lover
cues.zh: 我願接納眼前這位充滿磁性魅力的男人，成為我的終生愛侶
cues.text: I take this magnetic force of a man to be my lover

cues.en: My heart's been borrowed and yours has been blue
cues.zh: 我的心曾顛沛借人、你的心曾飽受憂傷
cues.text: My heart's been borrowed and yours has been blue

cues.en: All's well that ends well to end up with you
cues.zh: 但只要最終能與你攜手，過往一切苦痛便皆成圓滿
cues.text: All's well that ends well to end up with you

cues.en: Swear to be overdramatic and true to my lover
cues.zh: 我發誓對我的摯愛永遠保有孩子般的熱烈戲劇感與百分之百的忠誠
cues.text: Swear to be overdramatic and true to my lover

cues.en: And you'll save all your dirtiest jokes for me
cues.zh: 而你會把所有最私密俏皮的玩笑，通通留給我一人獨享
cues.text: And you'll save all your dirtiest jokes for me

cues.en: And at every table, I'll save you a seat, lover
cues.zh: 在未來的每一張餐桌旁，我也永遠都會為你預留身邊的座位，我的愛人
cues.text: And at every table, I'll save you a seat, lover

cues.en: Can I go where you go?
cues.zh: 你去哪裡，我能跟著你去嗎？
cues.text: Can I go where you go?

cues.zh: 我們能永遠永遠都如此緊緊相依嗎？
cues.text: Can we always be this close forever and ever?

cues.en: And ah, take me out, and take me home
cues.zh: 帶我盛裝出門約會，再帶我溫柔回家
cues.text: And ah, take me out, and take me home

cues.en: Forever and ever, you're my, my, my, my
cues.zh: 生生世世，你是我命中註定的
cues.text: Forever and ever, you're my, my, my, my

cues.en: Oh, you're my, my, my, my lover, lover, lover
cues.zh: 哦，你是我唯一的、無可取代的親愛戀人
cues.text: Oh, you're my, my, my, my lover, lover, lover
